notablePrerequisites: There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}. It'll enter with power equal to half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.
When Malignus enters, Champion of the Path triggers, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to its power doubled to each opponent due to The Rollercrusher Ride.
